shared_operations.identity_boundary: Purpose membership does not assert common chemistry, interchangeability or ancestry; a known difference plus other unknown fields does not prove disjointness. Original protocol nodes remain separate.
shared_operations.retrieval_boundary: This registry started empty. Initial embedding backend readiness and proposal-to-proposal comparisons do not establish retrieval recall against a populated registry.
shared_operations.withheld_reason: Wave-estimator concept claimed missing/rejected calls are retained as outputs; cited source describes exclusions but does not establish persisted/exported negative-call records. Whole 4sUDRB workflow remains published.

latency.conclusion: Observed extraction was about 85 minutes wall and complete driver about 127 minutes. Serial source compilation/review contributes about 31 minutes after extraction; this run does not meet a 30-minute end-to-end target.

usage.boundary: Aggregates recorded native request usage; cached input is a subset of input and reasoning output a subset of output. These are not unique corpus size, billed dollars, billing-account identification or newly purchased tokens.

behaviors_to_keep: Independent source-obligation generation, extraction and fresh review; one bounded correction retained all earlier artifacts.
All ten selected methods remain in the denominator; hiCLIP was withheld rather than silently dropped or retried until passing.
Material/data branches, origin identity, source-specific variants and chemistry/readout distinctions remain explicit in inspected DR, Drop, DBiT, SLAM, scBS and SPLiT examples.
Source review withheld the overclaimed wave-estimator definition while permitting the other supported units.
Exact workflow/packet/operation bindings attach shared concepts to local graphs without merging original operations or inventing historical development.
Available final artifacts and inputs were preserved outside scratch, with custody limitations carried forward.

failures_and_limits.finding: ATAC asserts analytical qPCR amplicons must not return to production as reported fact. Source describes separate monitoring and retained production branches but does not explicitly establish that categorical prohibition. Runtime primary review accepted this wording.
failures_and_limits.consequence: Published isolated parent still contains an attribution overstatement; softer concept wording does not repair it. Not proof that the physical assay route is wrong.
failures_and_limits.next_change: Review each consequential clause for reported vs inferred status, including prohibitions, material fate and implied negative outputs; include counterexamples in regression evaluation.

failures_and_limits.finding: Drop-seq grew from 22 to 39 Operations after ERCC and ddPCR characterization obligations became applicable through performance-context wording. Added branches are explicitly independent, but full historical endpoint reproduction was not necessary for the stated general-assay target.
failures_and_limits.next_change: Separate routine assay, decision-changing calibration/control and independent performance-characterization scope before requiring full branches. Do not delete necessary controls generically.

failures_and_limits.finding: The selected RNAhybrid software description still omits the cited prediction model's branching-structure (multiloop) exclusion; the frozen checklist already required it. This does not show that hiCLIP cannot sample branched biological RNAs.
failures_and_limits.consequence: hiCLIP needs_revision and no hiCLIP workflow was published.

failures_and_limits.finding: Neither of two predeclared shared library-preparation span questions was selected. Chosen cuts emphasize assay-distinctive cores.
failures_and_limits.consequence: No matching claim or recall estimate can be made for units never proposed. Two broad purpose groups do not establish comprehensive reusable-mechanism discovery.
failures_and_limits.next_change: Test selection coverage separately from membership precision on held-out shared transformations and misleading analogies; allow comparison-driven additional cuts under an explicit limit.

failures_and_limits.finding: 28 archived text sources have binary_provenance_not_declared_or_located across 4sUDRB, DBiT, ddRAD, DR and hiCLIP. Available text and its exact hashes are archived. This classification does not itself mean 28 missing PDFs; some source artifacts may be code, tables or native text.
failures_and_limits.consequence: No complete original-binary custody, complete supplement closure, image inspection or automatic missing-document recovery is established.
failures_and_limits.next_change: Register original documents and conversion lineage in fresh source records; first determine whether originals are recoverable before claiming missing scientific information.

failures_and_limits.next_change: Development-only deterministic ordering fix and cross-process regression; preserve the frozen runtime and historical final hash.

failures_and_limits.finding: An earlier independent audit failed to add hiCLIP source volume components correctly; another missed the wave output-retention clause. Both are explicitly corrected in later audits without rewriting earlier reports.
failures_and_limits.consequence: Agreement between agents and literal citation matches do not establish exhaustive scientific correctness.

failures_and_limits.finding: ddRAD draft took 42.69 minutes including four recorded CLI WebSocket reconnect errors; same thread recovered and completed. No host retry or proven process hang.
failures_and_limits.next_change: Separate provider transport, model work, unnecessary scope growth and serial curation when estimating latency.
